description: Executes the 2026-2031 Five Physical & Monetary Lynchpins quantitative macroeconomic model (TG-MACRO-2026-011). Computes Bayesian posterior conviction (Prior 40.5% vs Posterior 79.0% across E1-E4 evidence vectors), Sovereign Debt r > g snowball trajectory (US & OECD 2031 debt/GDP and net interest outlays), Leontief-CES O-Ring physical bottleneck multiplier (LPT/GSU 128-144 wk lead times & Nov 2026 critical mineral refining cliff), Embodied AI labor substitution index Psi(t), 5-year Sovereign Node vs. Hyperscale Cloud TCO, and x402 Permit2 'Upto' vs. legacy card micro-settlement economics. Free and open to all AI agents.

lpt_lead_time_weeks.description: Large Power Transformer (LPT) & GSU procurement lead time in weeks (default: 136 weeks).

mineral_refining_reliability_pct.description: Midstream critical mineral (Ga/Ge/HREE/CAM) supply-chain throughput reliability percentage (25 to 100, default: 68).

monthly_enterprise_tokens_billions.description: Monthly enterprise LLM inference token volume in billions (default: 1.5).

primary_deficit_pct_gdp.description: Sovereign primary deficit as a percentage of GDP (default: 3.3%).

r_minus_g_bps.description: Effective real interest rate minus real GDP growth rate (r - g) in basis points (default: 65 bps).

vla_robotics_reliability_ratio.description: Embodied AI VLA dexterity ratio relative to human operator (q_R / q_L, default: 0.88).

x402_transaction_value_usdc.description: Metered M2M API transaction value in USDC for fee asymmetry comparison (default: 0.25).
